class.name: IfcBoundaryCurve
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 ÿ A boundary curve is a type of bounded curve suitable for the definition of a surface boundary. NOTEÿ Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: boundary_curve. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p.89 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORYÿ New entity in IFC2x4.
